messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Switch the camera setup to a full-body shot from the front. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video, then follow the described front full-body camera setup and movement. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please switch the camera setup to a full-body shot from the front. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands still, then briefly raises his right hand to touch his face and chest before returning to a neutral standing pose.","camera":"A static, eye-level full-body shot frames the character from head to toe.","clothing":"He wears a light blue cable-knit sweater, blue-gray tapered pants, and brown shoes with green socks.","hair_color":"Light brown to blond.","hairstyle":"Short, cropped hair with a slightly textured top.","identity":"A 3D-rendered male character with a slim build, light skin, and a short beard stands centered in the frame.","scene":"The setting is a stylized, futuristic city street with tall buildings, neon signs, and a paved walkway under warm, low-angle sunlight."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output changes from a side profile view to a static front-facing full-body shot with the character centered, matching the reference framing. The character's clothing, hairstyle, and action sequence remain broadly consistent, and the futuristic city scene is retained.
arguments.requested_change: Switch to a front-facing full-body camera setup matching the reference image's viewing direction, subject placement, and framing, while preserving the character's identity, appearance, clothing, action, scene, and timing.
uncertain: Whether the subtle facial expression and exact action timing are fully preserved compared with the source.
unexpected_changes: The background composition differs from the source side view, with more buildings and neon signs visible behind the character, as expected from the new camera angle but not explicitly requested.
